What this tool does

All-in-one gym calculator with tabs for BMI, BMR + TDEE, Macros, Body Fat %, 1RM, Heart Rate Zones and Water Intake.

Uses Mifflin-St Jeor for BMR, US Navy method for body fat, Epley and Brzycki for 1RM.

For information only, not medical advice. Always consult a qualified professional.

Frequently asked questions

Is the gym calculator free to use?

Yes — Gym Calculator has no usage cap, no sign-up and no watermark, and it is not a trial: the page is a static file on https://wafasmart.tech with no billing backend behind it.

Does anything get uploaded when I use gym calculator?

No. Gym Calculator reads your calculator straight into page memory, works on it locally and hands the result back as a download — there is no upload request to intercept, store or leak, and no log of what you processed.

Which BMR formula is used?

Mifflin-St Jeor equation as it is widely recommended.

Is this medical advice?

No. For information only, not medical advice.
